title: FlexSectionRow
description: optionledger.flex_section_row r1: one revision of one row of a Flex statement section other than trades, attributes as sent without any account attribute, as text; insert only. No account number is stored: the alias is the only identity.

alias.description: Account alias of the row, the label mapped by the allow-list.

section.description: Row element name of the section in the Flex statement, for example CashTransaction; a pattern, so a later section needs no schema change.

row_key.description: Key attributes of the row joined with a bar, as text; an optional attribute that is absent is the empty text.

revision.description: Revision of the row for its key; 1 for a new key, a changed row is the next revision.

fetch_id.description: Identifier of the fetch that first wrote this revision.

row_index.description: Position of the row in its section of the report.

attributes.description: JSON object as text: every attribute of the row as sent, every value text, the account attributes removed.

attributes_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the attributes text, 64 lower-case hex digits.

recorded_at.description: Instant the row was recorded, UTC.
